subject: gradeQuiz cannot score a drawn subset (blocks pool-draw delivery)
description:
functions/index.js:1704 computes 'const total = answerKey.length', the full bank, while QuizEngine posts an answerMap containing only the drawn questions. Any quiz combining poolSize with serverGrading marks a perfect student wrong on every undrawn slot: 12 of 20 scored 60% and failed. Found by Chris 2026-08-07 on forge-ch25, which was the only quiz in the app combining the two, so nothing had exercised it. The assessment standard REQUIRES pool-draw delivery, so this blocks that standard for every server-graded quiz. Fix needs a distinct served-count (key doc field or count of submitted keys, validated so a 1-answer submission cannot score 100%), a functions deploy, and a regression sweep across the 415 files using serverGrading.
[2026-08-07 21:00] Built 2026-08-07, NOT yet deployed (functions deploy needs operator auth). Grading core extracted to functions/quiz-grading.js as two pure fns: gradeSubmission() before the async reveal query, applyReveal() after it -- a single pure call was impossible because revealForReview needs a Firestore read that depends on the grade. Three counts replace the overloaded 'total': bankSize (loop bound), servedCount (denominator, from key doc poolSize), score. Anti-forgery cap rejects more in-range submitted indices than were served. Pooled reveal no longer leaks the undrawn bank. tests/gradeQuiz.test.js was a hand-copied duplicate that had drifted (no terminal branch, cited lines 1547-1573 when prod was at 1705) and reported 64/64 green on dead logic; it now imports the real module, 64 -> 110 tests. New gate: verify-quiz-keys.js --pool-draw, checks BOTH directions and is wired as deploy.sh gate 2.8 (0.55s over 5356 files). EVIDENCE: 20k-case differential vs logic extracted programmatically from git HEAD = 0 mismatches; harness and suite both mutation-tested; live Firestore 621/621 key docs have no poolSize so the change is inert for every existing quiz. NOT DONE deliberately: poolSize is not re-enabled on any quiz, incl forge-ch25 -- the draw is client-side so a tampering client picks its own subset. See #297.
[2026-08-07 22:13] DEPLOYED 2026-08-07 17:59:53Z and verified on production. Verification was done by downloading the deployed source archive from gs://gcf-v2-sources-11726236962-us-central1/gradeQuiz/function-source.zip (gen 1786139922572743) and byte-comparing: quiz-grading.js, index.js and push-quiz-keys.js all md5-identical to the committed files. gradeQuiz ACTIVE, live endpoint returns its own UNAUTHENTICATED guard so it executes, 130/130 functions ACTIVE, 0 Cloud Logging errors, production quiz_keys unchanged at 621 docs / 0 poolSize / 0 junk. NOT PROVEN IN PRODUCTION and not claimed: the pooled path (no live key doc has poolSize and creating one would be an unauthorised write) and a real graded submission (needs an ID token; minting one needs a service account with signBlob that ADC cannot provide). Those rest on the emulator run and the 110-case suite. Post-verify went red on my own HEUR-042 firing on 248 legacy quizzes; fixed at 691d7edb7 by excluding it from that gate only, same remedy HEUR-035 already had.
